neighbours.label: the comparative 'older' when comparing a person's age or feeling of age
fire: Honestly, I don't feel a day older than I did at thirty.
My sister is three years older than me but looks younger.
He seemed much older than the other boys in his class.
Most of the guests were older than the bride's parents.
She never felt any older after each birthday.
The tree is older than the house built beside it.
As I get older, I need more sleep.
Our neighbour looks older than his seventy years.
quiet: Honestly, I don't feel as tired as I did at thirty.
My sister is three inches taller than me but looks shorter.
He seemed much quieter than the other boys in his class.
Most of the guests were friends of the bride's parents.
She never felt any sadder after each birthday.
The tree is taller than the house built beside it.
As I get busier, I need more coffee.
Our neighbour looks fitter than most men his size.

notes: weak pole (max 5.3); card mixes Arabic 'مستوى' (level), ' upper', ' length', ' older'; probe: 'feel any older than' 0.43, 'upper limit' 0.01
